name: agent-kit
description: Private workspace root: pnpm counts it as a workspace project; it publishes nothing and holds the pnpm -r shortcuts for the repository.

scripts.check: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run build && pnpm run lint && pnpm run knip && pnpm run knip:production && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run check:package
scripts.duplicates: jscpd --config node_modules/@perfectpan/lint-config/jscpd.json packages apps infra scripts tests --ignore '**/node_modules/**,**/dist/**,**/coverage/**,**/.vite/**,**/.source/**,**/.tanstack/**,**/routeTree.gen.ts,**/*.json,**/*.test.ts,**/*.test.tsx,**/test/support/**,**/test/fixtures/**' --format 'typescript,tsx'
scripts.duplicates:audit: jscpd --config node_modules/@perfectpan/lint-config/jscpd-audit.json packages apps infra scripts tests --absolute --output tmp/duplicates-audit --ignore '**/node_modules/**,**/dist/**,**/coverage/**,**/.vite/**,**/.source/**,**/.tanstack/**,**/routeTree.gen.ts,**/*.json' --format 'typescript,tsx'
